Claimed multi_document is not required. github-bug-bounty-program-legal-safe-harbor.md alone covers all three needs: section 1 safe-harbor coverage, section 2 third-party limits, section 3 limited waiver of other site policies. coordinated-disclosure-of-security-vulnerabilities.md is only a landing page linking to the bounty site and the safe-harbor policy. Fragmentation is real but intra-document (multi_section), not cross-document.
